faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for JMI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the JMI Recruitment 2026 is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned department before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in JMI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies for the posts of Asstt. Professor(Contractual-SFS) and Guest Faculty in Jamia Millia Islamia for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for JMI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Guest Faculty positions is Rs. 50000/- per month. For Asstt. Professor (Contractual-SFS), the pay is Basic pay in Academic Pay Level-10 + Applicable DA.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary by post, including B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech with First Class, Master's degree with 55% marks and NET/Ph.D, M.Sc Agriculture, MFA, and Postgraduate degrees in relevant disciplines and Education.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for JMI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 500/- for Asstt. Professor and Rs. 300/- for Guest Faculty. SC/ST and PwBD candidates have specific fee structures as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application submission, screening by the department, and an interview conducted by the Local Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Jamia Millia Islamia, which is http://jmi.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates along with the application form.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Jamia Millia Islamia?
faq.answer: The official website of Jamia Millia Islamia is http://jmi.ac.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and to download the application form.
